title: 全書庫輸出準確率深度分析與驗證缺陷修復
done_items: Completed library-wide accuracy analysis and healing across 128 chapters and 5 textbooks. Diagnosed and fixed 7 core issues: bold word merging, fallback vector text swallowing, running header false positives on uppercase punctuated headings, multi-line spanning caption column collapse, outline bookmark validation, adjacent inline math collision, and hanging preposition heading continuation. 100% (128/128) chapters passed verification and all 5 EPUBs generated with 10.0/10 Gate 2 audit scores.
